task: Build the replay campaign driver (run-batch.mjs): N generate+verify cycles per scale into a mkdtemp-isolated dir each, appending one identity-keyed proof-or-stop record per iteration to an append-only batch-ledger.jsonl (H1/H4 evidence).
outcome: node run-batch.mjs completes the full campaign (small N=30 + full N=3), batch-ledger.jsonl holds one proof-or-stop record per iteration with recordDigest, the driver exits nonzero on any recordless iteration + is lockfile-guarded, and a hermetic selfcheck exercises the budget_cap stop + lockfile + recordless-exit paths.
facts: M0 (B-9e44) froze protocol.json: N{small:30,full:3}, budgetCapMsPerVerify=128217, recordDigestPreimageRule, stopReasonEnum {budget_cap,verify_crash,precondition_failed,operator_abort}, iterationIdRule.
M1 (B-bae9) DONE (tamper arm). Both merged to main.
lib/instrument.mjs reusable: verifyDir ({status:crash} sentinel -> verify_crash stop), sha256, canonicalJson. Digests sourced from the generation-side result (verifier reports stability booleans).
Full scale materializes 1,000,000 records/cycle (~42.7s measured in M0); full N=3 is a budget decision.
H1 = pairwise records/gold/manifest digest + gold-metric equality across replay proof records per scale; H4 = each iteration within budgetCap OR a budget_cap stop.
constraints: All cycles in fresh mkdtemp dirs; no source pollution.
batch-ledger.jsonl is append-only + identity-keyed (never rewrite a line).
Every iteration ends in EXACTLY one record (proof XOR stop); recordless -> nonzero exit.
recordDigest = sha256 of the record canonical JSON with recordDigest absent.
unknowns: Whether all N replays at each scale are byte-identical in practice (expected yes; deterministic instrument) — established by the campaign run.
